{"subject":"Throughput per node for multi-region fraud scoring","body":"Hi Maya, thanks for connecting.

Northwind Payments runs fraud scoring on Astra DB with single-digit millisecond reads across three regions at 40k transactions per second, and at that scale throughput per node matters. ScyllaDB delivers higher throughput per node, which typically means fewer nodes and lower infrastructure cost. With DataStax now part of IBM, this may be a reasonable moment to review options.

Would you be open to comparing notes on what that could look like for your fraud-scoring workload?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB

Reply STOP to opt out.","evidence_ids":["s01"],"value_prop_ids":["vp_tco"],"context_fact_ids":["cf_ibm"]}
